scripts.test:sites: npm run build:sites && npm --prefix sites/film-workspace test
scripts.test:sites:browser: npm run build:sites && npm --prefix sites/film-workspace run test:browser
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:fallback && npm test && npm --prefix sites/film-workspace run quality
scripts.format: node sites/film-workspace/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config sites/film-workspace/.prettierrc.json --write AGENTS.md README.md package.json .github/workflows/quality.yml docs/*.md docs/*.json scripts/check-fallback.mjs scripts/sync-sites-source.mjs tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: node sites/film-workspace/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config sites/film-workspace/.prettierrc.json --check AGENTS.md README.md package.json .github/workflows/quality.yml docs/*.md docs/*.json scripts/check-fallback.mjs scripts/sync-sites-source.mjs tests/*.test.mjs
